notes.title: The Little Tomb - Steam Next Fest Demo Out Now!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="0mTiyokr2dE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body has a new demo for Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient Japanese tomb who goes on a journey to search for a dead body to be buried in his body.[/p][p]In the Steam Next Fest demo, the main characters are voiced by Akari Kito (Kofun) and Yuka Nukui (Haniwa)! Enjoy the wholesome atmosphere and basic gameplay of the game as you explore the park and check off your To-Do List. What’s more, beating the demo reveals some super-secret facts about Kofun and Haniwa...[/p][p]Please check out the demo and experience a unique world inhabited by both humans and haniwa.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: The demo version does not have a save function. We appreciate your understanding.[/p][p][/p][h2]PLAYISM[/h2][p][url="https://twitter.com/playismEN"]X (formerly Twitter)[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/playismen.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/PLAYISM/"]Facebook[/url][/p][p][url="https://playism.com/en/"]PLAYISM Official Site[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Playism"]PLAYISM Publisher Page[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/pBKJG5PsVp"]Official PLAYISM Discord[/url][/p]
